description: Ittehad Chemicals Limited is a Pakistani chlor-alkali manufacturer whose complex at Kala Shah Kaku in Sheikhupura district began production in 1964. The company was nationalised in 1972 and privatised in 1995, and after successive capacity expansions its plant can produce 425 tonnes a day of caustic soda. It also makes liquid chlorine, hydrochloric acid, sodium sulphate, sodium hypochlorite, calcium chloride and carbon dioxide, sold across Pakistan and exported to the GCC. In 2019 it diversified into surfactants (LABSA and SLES).
